{{Hatnote|1=Transcript: [[Star Wars CCG TV Ad (1996) (transcript)]].}}
'''Star Wars CCG TV Ad (1996)''' is a 31-second television commercial for the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]]. Lusco-fusco posted the surviving copy to YouTube on 14 December 2020. The voice-over closes with the tagline "the galaxy in a box".<ref name="yt-tv" />
